summary: Tested profile attendance feature set across backend APIs and UI admin flows. Admin picker, month/deep-link behavior, register rendering, and grid parity passed. Two acceptance areas remain unverified in this preview: non-admin access behavior (documented member creds return 401) and former-member scoped profile (no status=left member available).

minor.issue: Documented non-admin test credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (coach.test@example.com/Admin@12345, dar.test@example.com/Dar@12345, exec.test@example.com/Exec@12345) returned 401 in this preview, blocking direct verification of non-admin 403 gating on /api/admin/members/{id}/attendance-month.
Former-member scoped profile scenario could not be verified because no status=left member was present in /api/members response for this preview dataset.

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete because documented non-admin email logins fail with 401; profile page was not reachable as non-admin in this run.

action_items: Fix/refresh non-admin preview credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (or seed an active member test account) so non-admin profile spoof checks can be completed.
Provide at least one historical/former member (status=left) in preview data to validate scoped former-member attendance against main-grid exclusion.
If credential/data fixtures are restored, rerun only skipped checks: non-admin 403 for admin member endpoint + non-admin /profile picker hidden + former-member scoped profile behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: MemberProfilePicker currently loads full /api/members dataset and filters client-side. Works functionally here, but with larger rosters this may create unnecessary payload and stale-search UX; consider server-side search/pagination later.
Requested auth playbook file /app/auth_testing.md is missing in workspace (path not found), so optional auth regression checks from playbook instructions were not executable in this iteration.

success_rate.backend: 86% of planned checks validated (12 passed, 2 skipped)
success_rate.frontend: ~85% of requested checks validated (all admin profile flows passed; non-admin flow blocked by credentials)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin UI flow validated on https://youth-regatta-app.preview.emergentagent.com/profile with sampled IDs staff=regatta-admin-1 and athlete=regatta-admin-1. Deep-link /profile?member=regatta-admin-1&month=2026-08 and reload both rendered correct member/month. Responsive overflow checks passed at 390, 768, 1024, 1440 widths. Non-admin login attempts returned 401, so spoof-proof UI behavior remains unverified.
rca of the issue: Primary blockers were environment/test-fixture related, not feature regressions: (1) documented non-admin credentials do not authenticate in this preview, so role-gated checks skip/fail at login boundary; (2) no former-member row available to test scoped historical access path. Core implementation under test (admin picker + monthly register + grid parity) behaved consistently across backend and frontend validations.
